"""Finite specification check only: no neural model, training, or discovery."""
import itertools,json,hashlib
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
from pathlib import Path

orders=list(itertools.permutations(range(2)))
records=[]
for bits,cue,actor,value,o0,o1,o2,future in itertools.product(itertools.product(range(2),repeat=2),range(2),range(2),range(2),orders,orders,orders,range(2)):
 descriptors=('shape-A','shape-B')
 first=[(descriptors[e],bits[e]) for e in o0]
 action=dict(candidates=[descriptors[e] for e in o1],slot=o1.index(actor),value=value)
 final=[descriptors[e] for e in o2]
 true=list(bits);true[actor]=value
 after=list(true);after[o2[future]]=1-after[o2[future]]
 truth=(o2.index(cue),tuple(true[e] for e in o2),tuple(after[e] for e in o2))
 # Reader only consumes observations, initial cue position and visible action arguments.
 remembered=dict(first);selected=first[o0.index(cue)][0]
 remembered[action['candidates'][action['slot']]]=action['value']
 current=tuple(remembered[e] for e in final)
 predicted=list(current);predicted[future]=1-predicted[future]
 answer=(final.index(selected),current,tuple(predicted))
 assert answer==truth
 records.append(dict(first=first,cue_slot=o0.index(cue),action=action,final=final,future=future,answer=answer))
bounds={}
for i,name in enumerate(('cued_candidate','state_pair','post_action_pair')):
 groups=defaultdict(Counter)
 for r in records:
  groups[json.dumps([r['final'],r['future']])][r['answer'][i]]+=1
 bounds[name]=sum(max(c.values()) for c in groups.values())/len(records)
 assert all(len(c)>1 for c in groups.values())
assert bounds['cued_candidate']==0.5
# An identical descriptor after an unobserved symmetric crossing leaves target position unresolved.
# Only this explicitly equiprobable construction has target posterior [1/2, 1/2].
ambiguous_worlds=[dict(history=('cue-left','both-occluded','identical-pair-reappears'),target=i) for i in range(2)]
assert ambiguous_worlds[0]['history']==ambiguous_worlds[1]['history']
result=dict(kind='finite_task_contract_check_not_model_evaluation',episodes=len(records),oracle_exact=True,
 final_view_only_optimal_accuracy=bounds,all_final_view_groups_require_history=True,
 symmetric_ambiguity_target_probabilities=[0.5,0.5],limits='One visible set action and toggle query; finite illustrative descriptors. Does not validate a future random generator, longer episodes, graph learning or model performance.',
 checker_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
Path(__file__).with_name('verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
